test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, who among the following is the CEO of Teach for India, an educational non-profit organisation that runs a two year fellowship program and alumni network to foster educational excellence and leadership in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shaheen Mistri**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shaheen Mistri** is the **CEO and founder** of **Teach for India (TFI)**, an educational non-profit organization that works to eliminate educational inequity in India.
 
• She established TFI in **2009** with the mission to address the disparities in education quality across the country
